senses.sense_definition: An academic conference, seminar, or meeting organized for discussion and presentations on specific scholarly topics.

examples.text: The physics department hosts an annual <w>colloquium</w> featuring researchers from across the country.
Graduate students are strongly encouraged to attend every departmental <w>colloquium</w> this semester.

senses.sense_definition: A meeting, conference, or formal conversation held for mutual discussion.

examples.text: The international committee gathered for a three-day <w>colloquium</w> on regional environmental policy.
Leaders from several institutions participated in a fruitful <w>colloquium</w> regarding technological standards.

senses.sense_definition: A formal lecture or address delivered to an academic seminar or conference.

examples.text: The visiting scholar delivered a fascinating <w>colloquium</w> on quantum thermodynamics yesterday afternoon.
Her inaugural <w>colloquium</w> attracted faculty members and researchers from various related disciplines.

senses.sense_definition: In defamation law, the portion of a formal complaint establishing that the defamatory statements referred to the plaintiff.

examples.text: The court dismissed the lawsuit because the plaintiff failed to include a sufficient <w>colloquium</w> in the filing.
Without a clear <w>colloquium</w>, the complaint did not adequately link the offending remarks to the claimant.
